title: Noak Hellsing releases his EP debut “YESTERYEAR”
htmlContent:
Swedish sensation Noak Hellsing has left a trail of euphoria in the wake of his debut EP, "YESTERYEAR." At just 20 years old, Hellsing has masterfully encapsulated the essence of youthful nostalgia, delivering a mesmerizing six-track journey through time and emotion.

EP Pre-listen:: https://song.space/7p7lcp

"YESTERYEAR" presents a musical paradox – a blend of timeless storytelling and modern pop sensibilities. Hellsing's vocal prowess is on full display, evoking the raw emotions of artists beyond his years. The EP combines four previously released gems with two brand-new tracks:

Get Real

Die Without Letting You Know

When The Shadows Go Home

Break My Heart  (focus track)

When You Think Of Me (New)

Enemy

The EP is a testament to Hellsing's growth and artistry, a testament to his five-year musical journey. Not only does he shine as a solo artist with a charming voice but he's also a sought-after songwriter, with collaborations that read like a who's who of contemporary music.

"Break My Heart" takes center stage, delivering an infectious hook and emotional depth. "When You Think Of Me" further showcases Hellsing's ability to craft timeless ballads. The EP is a 15-minute musical experience that will transport you back to the treasured moments of yesteryear.

In addition to his solo project, Noak, as a songwriter, has collaborated with creators such as Aldae, Erik Hassle, Corey Sanders, LIOHN, Siba, Tep No, Michael Calfan, and NCT Dream. And currently, he has ongoing projects with DJ Snake, Armin Van Buuren, Punctual, and Toby Romeo.

"Noak Hellsing Takes Us Back in Time with 'YESTERYEAR' - A Pop Triumph!" is a must-listen. Hellsing's debut EP is a testament to his talent, ensuring his place in the pop pantheon. "YESTERYEAR" arrives on October 19, 2023 – mark your calendars and prepare to be enchanted by the artistry of a rising star.
